instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: cancel an existing order by maker or cancel when expired
returns the tokens back to the maker and close the compressed escrow PDA aacount

accounts.name: maker
docs: The maker of the order - must be signer for non-expired orders
For expired orders, anyone can cancel

instructions.name: close_protocol_ata
docs: Close empty protocol vault token accounts

instructions.name: create_ata
docs: To send the output tokens to the maker, maker needs to have an associated token account
usallay created when initializing the order but if they close we create it
take samll amount from the making amount and swap it wSOL and send it to the payer
payer create the ATA

accounts.name: maker_token_ata
docs: Maker token ATA to be created

instructions.name: create_ata_wsol
docs: If the making tokens is WSOL then no need to swap
take small amount from it and send it payer
payer create the output ATA.
update's the amount state. sub both making and taking amount

instructions.name: expire_wsol_order
docs: when the input_mint is WSOL, to unwrap it back to sol, during cancel the wsol is transferrred to maker wsol ata
the maker ata can only be closed by the maker. so while expiring the order we can't unwrap
since the funds are stored in a protocol vault, and can't close it. So we will create a new
temporary ata owned the Program, transfer the wsol to that ata and close it with
destination = maker. this will unwrap the wsol back to SOL
friction less limit orders mf

accounts.name: maker
docs: For expired orders, anyone can cancel (including workers/keepers)

instructions.name: fill_order
docs: fill the order when the price reaches the user target
this instruction will be called by a worker that is monitoring the price
swap's the token in vault using jupiter cpi
close or update the light compressed escrow account
transfer the output tokens to the maker

instructions.name: initialize_order
docs: This function creates a compressed escrow account using Light Protocol's state compression
stores the order details amount and tokens
Transfers the maker's input tokens to the protocol vault

instructions.name: update_order
docs: Update an existing order, change the making and taking amount
change the expiry time

errors.name: InvalidEscrowOwner
errors.msg: Invalid escrow owner: the escrow must be owned by the program ID

errors.name: InvalidOutAmount
errors.msg: Invalid output amount: exactly 2,039,280 lamports required to create a token account

errors.name: InvalidJupInstructionData
errors.msg: Invalid Jupiter instruction data: must be an exact-out route or shared-accounts exact-out route

errors.name: InvalidInAmount
errors.msg: Invalid input amount: must match the escrow account's making amount

errors.name: InvalidEscrowMaker
errors.msg: Invalid escrow maker: must match the escrow account maker

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Invalid amount: must be greater than 0

errors.name: InvalidExpiration
errors.msg: Invalid expiration: must be in the future

errors.name: SameMints
errors.msg: Input and output mints cannot be the same

errors.name: AmountTooLarge
errors.msg: Amount too large for safe calculations

errors.name: InvalidPlatformFeeBps
errors.msg: Invalid platform fee BPS: must be either 0 or 10

errors.name: InvalidCreateAtaInstruction
errors.msg: Invalid instruction: to create an ATA for SOL, call `create_ata_wsol` instead

errors.name: SolAtaCreatedSeparately
errors.msg: SOL ATA must be created separately

errors.name: InvalidFeeAccount
errors.msg: Invalid fee token account in jupiter accounts. The fee account must be ata of input_mint
